newsitem.title: CHINA: Group forms for Peace Bank of Korea US$40 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Group forms for Peace Bank of Korea US$40 mln FRCD.

text.p: Peace Bank of Korea's US$40 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been allotted, arranger WestLB said on Friday.
The facility has a final maturity of three years with a put and a call option in year two. The issue was priced at par to float at 60 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 78 basis points.
Arrangers and lead managers, with US$5 million each, are Goldman Sachs Asia, KDB Asia, KEXIM Asia, and WestLB Asia Pacific.
Co-lead manager ING Barings committed US$5 million.
Senior managers with US$3 million each are Kookmin Finance Asia, Shinhan Bank and Sumitomo Finance Asia.
Other senior managers with US$2 million each are Credit Lyonnais, Hanil Bank Singapore and London Forfaiting Asia.
